query_text: which came first the walking dead comic or show

message.content:
Based on my search, **The Walking Dead comic came first**.

The comic book series was created by **Robert Kirkman** with art by **Tony Moore** and was first published by **Image Comics in 2003**. The television adaptation didn't premiere until **October 31, 2010** on AMC, meaning the comic predated the show by about **7 years**.

The comic ran for 193 issues, concluding in July 2019, while the TV series ran for 11 seasons from 2010 to 2022. The show was developed by Frank Darabont and became a massive cultural phenomenon, but it was always an adaptation of the original comic source material.
